lines: Shivraj Singh Kandhari, guardian of Bikramjit Singh Kandhari, is due proceeds because they sell 100 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹0.00 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Caveat: the gain and retained holding are unknown, as the average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed.
